notes: Bay Area Reporter, 6 January 2000 to 27 December 2001, 104 weekly issues, read from the Internet Archive's DjVu text (no hOCR). Hand-curated: address clusters and event-word passages were read and each finding's quote checked against the issue. People rule as in the dossier: no owners, managers, staff, performers or patrons.

coverage.remaining: 2002 to 2005 remain: 187 issues in the collection, January 2002 to 28 July 2005.
coverage.note: 104 issues; 12,209 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, 975 windows after the advertisement filter (592 of them rescued for an event word) in 891 address clusters, of which 469 hold an event word; the tighter filter left 108, all read; plus 767 event-word passages, of which the 28 with a fire, closing, lost-lease or moving word and no out-of-town or review marker were read. 24 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text. All 24 resolved and published, on 23 pages, none seeded; 1 of them placed by hand (the Castro Theatre, printed as 427 Castro Street, on its page at 429). The audit flags 3 of 24: the Stop AIDS Project's Polk office, whose number the paper prints only in 1998; and two details taken from elsewhere than the cited passage, Pottery Barn's 1999 announcement (further on in the same story) and the 2,900 square feet at 400 Castro (the issue of 13 December 2001, as the placement note says).
